knownGaps: Browser visual layout, desktop/mobile pixel appearance and native keyboard default traversal not verified; JSDOM geometry/scroll stubs are explicit.
All conversations, contact profiles and account defaults are upstream fixtures, not live messages/accounts.
No actual message sending, attachment upload, voice/video call, account save, team creation, billing or sign-out; unsupported original controls disabled.
Original NewChat only collects selected users and displays showSubmittedData; no conversation is created.
Original form validators and fields retained; settings receipts are local only. Appearance changes iframe theme/font choice only, with no cookie/storage persistence.
All avatar images disabled; original AvatarFallback reused. NewChat bare img replaced by same-source AvatarFallback/initials. Fonts are system fallback, no remote Inter/Manrope fetched.
Only /chats and /settings plus its four named subpages are registered in memory history; original global navigation dataset is filtered to these local routes.
